'''Imperial Edict 936''' was passed during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]] regarding the tombs of the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=general|Imperial Edict|[[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]}}</ref>

==History==
In response to raiders looting tombs on Korriban the Empire issued this edict to deal with the new threat to the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] homeworld. The edict specifically authorized the use of "deadly force" against tomb raiders found looting. [[Rikel (Imperial Army)|Sergeant Rikel]] of the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] was ordered to carry out to this order and sent in his men to clear [[Tomb of Ajunta Pall|Ajunta Pall's tomb]]. His units were killed and the tomb was later cleared by a [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolyte]].<ref name="TOR" />
